source.citation: Hirao, H., Yamada, K., Takahashi, H., Zibara, H. (2005). Chloride binding of cement estimated by binding isotherms of hydrates. Journal of Advanced Concrete Technology 3(1), 77-84.
source.location: Figs. 5 and 7, p. 80, and their regression curves; the sorption test, section 2.2, p. 78

transcription.from: the published article (PDF). The two figures are vector drawings: each marker is a filled square whose center was read from its coordinates in the page and mapped through the axis frame, whose corners carry the tick labels 0 and 5 (concentration) and 0.0 and 1.0 (bound chloride) to within 0.04 pt. The regression curves are printed on the figures and are transcribed as printed.
transcription.note: C-S-H made by hydrating synthesized alite at a water to solid ratio of 10, 56 days sealed at 20 C, dried in acetone and at 11 % RH; 1 g of it in 10 cm3 of NaCl solution for 2 days at 20 C; chloride in the filtrate by ion chromatography, the bound chloride from the depletion. The hydrate contains portlandite, quantified by DSC, and Fig. 7 is Fig. 5 recalculated per gram of C-S-H alone: at the four points above 0.1 mol/L the digitized ratio is 1.310 to 1.313, the ratio of the printed capacities being 0.61602/0.47001 = 1.3107. The concentration is the one in the solution after the test (the axis reads Cl- concentration). The printed rate constants differ in the fifth digit, 2.64987 (Fig. 5) and 2.64947 (Fig. 7); both are transcribed.

temperature_C.description: Temperature of the sorption tests, in degrees Celsius.

solution_volume.description: Volume of NaCl solution per test.

contact_time.description: Duration of the sorption test, checked by the authors to be enough for saturation.

langmuir_capacity_hydrate.description: Capacity of the Langmuir curve fitted to the bound chloride per gram of hydrated alite, portlandite included.

langmuir_constant_hydrate.description: Constant of the Langmuir curve of Fig. 5.

langmuir_capacity_csh.description: Capacity of the Langmuir curve per gram of C-S-H, the portlandite of the hydrate deducted.

langmuir_constant_csh.description: Constant of the Langmuir curve of Fig. 7.

binding_hydrate.location: Fig. 5, p. 80: chloride in solution after the test, and chloride bound per gram of hydrated alite (portlandite included), read from the vector drawing

binding_csh.location: Fig. 7, p. 80: the same tests, per gram of C-S-H, read from the vector drawing

notes: The mass fraction of portlandite in the hydrate is not printed. It follows from the two printed capacities, 1 - 0.47001/0.61602 = 0.237, since Fig. 7 is Fig. 5 divided by the mass fraction of C-S-H.
The bound chloride at 3.47 mol/L is lower than at 1.96 mol/L in both figures; the Langmuir curves are fitted through all six points.
